name: Fly.io Machines
description: Firecracker microVMs with suspend/resume across 18+ regions.
descriptionZh: 可 suspend/resume、覆盖 18+ 区域的 Firecracker microVM。
keyFact: Fly.io Machines are hardware-virtualized Firecracker microVMs that boot in under a second and can suspend and resume, spanning more than 18 regions; Fly also ships Sprites, a persistent checkpoint/restore product aimed at agents.
keyFactZh: Fly.io Machines 是硬件虚拟化的 Firecracker microVM，启动低于 1 秒并支持挂起/恢复，覆盖 18 个以上区域；Fly 另提供面向 Agent 的持久化 checkpoint/restore 产品 Sprites。
caveat: Managed-only; the platform is proprietary and flyctl (the CLI) is Apache-2.0.
caveatZh: 仅托管，平台为专有，flyctl（CLI）为 Apache-2.0。
